Replays tested on Hermes Agent

No replay has run on Hermes Agent. All 51 replays ran on Claude Code only, so this page makes no claim about Hermes Agent.

What the Hermes Agent setup page says about coverage

Wrap gates the commands you route through it. Hermes invocations made any other way (an interactive session, an unwrapped script) never touch KYA. Coverage is exactly the set of invocations you wrap, no more.

Source: the Hermes Agent recipe.

Install

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
